# ls_interaction

Targeting/interaction system — attach context-menu options to peds, vehicles, objects, players, model hashes, network entities, local entities, or zones. Player holds **Alt** to raycast against nearby interactables; NUI menu shows on click. All exports are client-side: `exports["ls_interaction"]:Fn(...)`.

## InteractionOption

```lua
---@class InteractionOption
---@field label string Display text (required)
---@field name? string Unique ID for removal; auto-generated if omitted
---@field icon? string FontAwesome class, e.g. "fas fa-hand"
---@field color? string Icon colour, e.g. "#ffffff"
---@field distance? number Max show distance (default 2.5)
---@field onSelect? fun(data: InteractionData) Callback on select
---@field canInteract? fun(entity, distance, data): boolean Hide option dynamically
---@field bones? string|string[]|number|number[] Restrict to specific bones
---@field offset? vector3 Local-space offset activation point
---@field absoluteOffset? boolean Treat offset as world-space
---@field offsetSize? number Activation radius around offset (default 1.0)
---@field subOptions? InteractionOption[] Nested sub-menu (not combinable with onSelect)
---@field export? string Export name to call on select
---@field event? string Client event to trigger
---@field serverEvent? string Server event to trigger
---@field command? string Command to execute
---@field resource? string Resource name (auto-populated)
```

```lua
---@class InteractionSettings
---@field drawSprite? boolean Draw dot indicator (default true)
---@field drawSpriteDistance? number Max distance for the dot
---@field markIcon? string Tabler icon above entity (first registration wins)
---@field markColor? string Hex colour for the mark icon
```

## Global targets

```lua
---@param options InteractionOption|InteractionOption[]
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalPed(options)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalVehicle(options)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalObject(options)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalPlayer(options)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalOption(options) -- always-present global slot

---@param names string|string[]
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveGlobalPed(names)
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveGlobalVehicle(names)
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveGlobalObject(names)
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveGlobalPlayer(names)
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveGlobalOption(names)
```

```lua
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddGlobalPed({
    label = "Talk",
    icon = "fas fa-comment",
    distance = 2.0,
    onSelect = function(data) print("Ped:", data.entity) end
})
```

## Model / entity targets

```lua
---@param models string|number|(string|number)[]
---@param options InteractionOption|InteractionOption[]
---@param settings? InteractionSettings
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddModel(models, options, settings)
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveModel(models, names)

---@param netIds number|number[]
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddEntity(netIds, options, settings) -- by network ID
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveEntity(netIds, names)

---@param entityIds number|number[]
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddLocalEntity(entityIds, options, settings) -- client-local handle
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveLocalEntity(entityIds, names)
```

```lua
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddEntity(netId, {
    { label = "Inspect", onSelect = function(data) end }
}, { drawSprite = true })
```

## Zones

```lua
---@class ZoneOption
---@field coords vector3 Zone centre
---@field size? vector3 Box zone size
---@field radius? number Sphere zone radius
---@field points? vector3[] Poly zone corners
---@field heading? number Rotation in degrees (box only)
---@field minZ? number Min Z boundary
---@field maxZ? number Max Z boundary
---@field name? string Unique zone name
---@field debug? boolean Show debug visualisation
-- plus all InteractionOption fields

---@param data ZoneOption
---@return number zoneId
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddPolyZone(data)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddBoxZone(data)
exports["ls_interaction"]:AddSphereZone(data)

---@param zoneId number|string
---@return boolean
exports["ls_interaction"]:ZoneExists(zoneId)

---@param zoneId number|string
---@param suppressWarning? boolean
exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveZone(zoneId, suppressWarning)
```

```lua
local id = exports["ls_interaction"]:AddBoxZone({
    coords = vector3(100.0, 200.0, 30.0),
    size = vector3(4.0, 4.0, 2.0),
    heading = 0.0,
    options = { { label = "Enter", event = "MyResource:Client:Enter" } }
})

exports["ls_interaction"]:RemoveZone(id)
```

## Querying

```lua
---@param entity? number
---@param entityType? number
---@param model? number
---@return TargetOptionsResult
exports["ls_interaction"]:GetTargetOptions(entity, entityType, model)
```

## Events

| Event | Direction | Payload | Notes |
|-------|-----------|---------|-------|
| `Interaction:Server:SetEntityHasOptions` | client→server | `netId: number` | Sets `hasTargetOptions = true` state bag |
| `Interaction:Server:RemoveEntity` | client→server | `netIds: number[]` | Clears state bag, broadcasts removal |
| `Interaction:Client:RemoveEntity` | server→client | `netIds: number[]` | Purges locally cached options |

> Options are scoped to the registering resource and auto-removed on `onResourceStop`. Networked entities with options get `hasTargetOptions = true` set server-side so other systems can detect them.
